title: Home-Site Lease Late Fee and Courtesy Waiver Schedule
content:
For each lot class of the Home-Site Lease this schedule lists the late-fee grace days, the late-fee percentage, the late-fee minimum and maximum for one billing period, and the courtesy waiver allowance.

- **Grace days**: calendar days after the due day during which rent may be paid without a late fee.
- **Late-fee percentage**: the percentage of the site rent and occupant charges for the billing period still unpaid at the end of the grace period.
- **Late-fee minimum and maximum**: the floor and the cap of the late fee for one billing period.
- **Courtesy waivers per 12 months**: the number of late fees that may be waived as a courtesy in any trailing 12-month window.
- **Tenure for a courtesy waiver**: full months of tenancy since the move-in date required before a courtesy late-fee waiver may be granted.

| Lot class | Grace days | Late-fee percentage | Minimum (USD) | Maximum (USD) | Courtesy waivers per 12 months | Tenure for a courtesy waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 5 | 5.0 percent | 35.00 | 60.00 | 1 | 12 months |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 5 | 5.0 percent | 35.00 | 60.00 | 1 | 12 months |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 5 | 5.0 percent | 35.00 | 75.00 | 1 | 12 months |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 5 | 5.0 percent | 35.00 | 75.00 | 1 | 12 months |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 5 | 5.0 percent | 35.00 | 75.00 | 1 | 12 months |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 5 | 5.0 percent | 35.00 | 90.00 | 1 | 12 months |

The lot classes differ only in the maximum: 60.00 on the single-section lot classes, 75.00 on the Standard, Preferred and Greenbelt Multi-Section lot classes and 90.00 on the Lakefront Multi-Section lot class.
